Class ImportJobRegistry.Job

java.lang.Object
com.sebastiandorata.musicdashboard.service.Import.ImportJobRegistry.Job
All Implemented Interfaces:
ImportOrchestrator.ImportCallbacks
Enclosing class:
ImportJobRegistry
public static final class ImportJobRegistry.Job extends Object implements ImportOrchestrator.ImportCallbacks
Mutable job state shared between the pipeline thread (writer) and request threads (readers).

Doubles as the callback object passed to ImportOrchestrator.process(List, ImportOrchestrator.ImportCallbacks).
